investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (409 Conflict)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T23:07:58Z with an identical 409 Conflict response from POST /api/agents, carrying the message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because the failure occurs at the agent creation step shared by all three checks, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, and the expected-output contract was fully unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm backend rejected every POST /api/agents request issued by the eval runner with HTTP 409 and error code "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because agent creation is the first step in the runner branch for all three remote-agents checks (run-status-probes.mjs line 1339: `createAgent(args, track, "remote", null, orgId)`), the quota error terminates execution before any evidence can be written, causing a complete contract gap for orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, and remoteState. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production-api swarm service; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigation.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on Agent Runtime Endpoint in production-api
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 response from the agent runtime endpoint, causing the stream to emit a generation_error frame instead of generation_completed and leaving imageUrlPresent false. This is an eval-layer failure localized to the /api/generate/image/stream endpoint's agent runtime session-open path in the production-api environment; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigation.rootCause: The agent runtime endpoint required to open a session for image generation returned HTTP 404 when the eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream in the production-api environment. The stream emitted a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version. Verify the harness deployment and the LOCAL_HARNESS_URL / SWARM_BASE_URL configuration." This caused the stream to terminate without ever emitting a generation_completed frame or an image artifact URL, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract. The precise underlying cause — whether the harness is undeployed, misconfigured (wrong LOCAL_HARNESS_URL or SWARM_BASE_URL), or running an incompatible version — cannot be determined from the supplied evidence alone and requires direct inspection of the harness deployment and environment configuration.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T23:07:58Z with an identical 409 Conflict response from POST /api/agents, carrying the message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because the failure occurs at the agent creation step shared by all three checks, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, and the expected-output contract was fully unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The swarm backend rejected every POST /api/agents request issued by the eval runner with HTTP 409 and error code "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because agent creation is the first step in the runner branch for all three remote-agents checks (run-status-probes.mjs line 1339: `createAgent(args, track, "remote", null, orgId)`), the quota error terminates execution before any evidence can be written, causing a complete contract gap for orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, and remoteState. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production-api swarm service; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on Agent Runtime Endpoint in production-api
investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 response from the agent runtime endpoint, causing the stream to emit a generation_error frame instead of generation_completed and leaving imageUrlPresent false. This is an eval-layer failure localized to the /api/generate/image/stream endpoint's agent runtime session-open path in the production-api environment; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigations.rootCause: The agent runtime endpoint required to open a session for image generation returned HTTP 404 when the eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream in the production-api environment. The stream emitted a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version. Verify the harness deployment and the LOCAL_HARNESS_URL / SWARM_BASE_URL configuration." This caused the stream to terminate without ever emitting a generation_completed frame or an image artifact URL, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract. The precise underlying cause — whether the harness is undeployed, misconfigured (wrong LOCAL_HARNESS_URL or SWARM_BASE_URL), or running an incompatible version — cannot be determined from the supplied evidence alone and requires direct inspection of the harness deployment and environment configuration.
